description: This file implements a message queue interface using System V IPC mechanisms, including functions for generating queue keys, creating, sending, and receiving messages, and managing message queue lifecycle.

classes.name: SysVMessageQueue
classes.description: A class encapsulating a System V message queue, managing its creation, destruction, and message operations.

methods.name: GenerateQueueKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for the message queue based on a string input, using a hash function.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::SysVMessageQueue
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message queue with an ID and auto-close flag.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::~SysVMessageQueue
methods.description: Destructor that removes the message queue if auto-close is enabled.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Create
methods.description: Creates or opens a message queue with a given name, returning a unique pointer to the queue object.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the queue, with optional blocking behavior.

methods.name: SysVMessageQueue::Receive
methods.description: Receives a message from the queue, with options for message type and blocking.
